responses.content:
Dan Finlay is one of the original co-founders/creators of MetaMask, alongside Aaron Davis, developed under ConsenSys.

His main contribution was helping build MetaMask as a browser extension wallet that let ordinary web browsers interact with Ethereum decentralized applications. MetaMask managed users’ Ethereum accounts/keys and injected a Web3/Ethereum provider into web pages, making it much easier for dapps to request transactions and connect to users.

Historically, MetaMask emerged around 2016, before today’s large consumer crypto-wallet ecosystem existed, and became one of the key pieces of Ethereum infrastructure. Finlay has also been associated with MetaMask’s developer experience, security/permissions thinking, and public discussions about wallet design and user safety.

I’m not certain of every title he has held over time, but he is widely known as a MetaMask co-founder and early lead builder.
